topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The spot where I stood used to be a place of quiet whispers and shadowy dances. My hands, small back then, had pressed this sapling into the earth. Each year, it had grown alongside me, its leaves a canopy of memories. Now, here stands bare soil, silent and void. The air doesn’t carry the scent of pine and rain anymore. It’s as if the sky itself has been chopped, leaving me with this open, echoing space. I trace the outlines of where the roots once held firmly, as if by touching, I could will them back into being. But the ground is cold, and the sun feels wrong, too bright on this emptiness.
